title: devices.json computer_sessions
description: The computer sessions of the person (table computer_sessions): which agent in which run of the person controlled which desktop when, pauses, the number of actions, the last frontmost app and the reason for the end. Never an image, a coordinate, typed text or a key.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent that controlled the desktop.

run_id.description: ID of the run of the person the session belonged to.

started_at.description: When the host service started the session.

paused_ms.description: Milliseconds the session was paused while the screen was locked.

action_count.description: Number of actions of the agent.

front_app.description: Identity of the last frontmost app.
